items.title: U.S. Stock Futures Fall on AI Trade Concerns
items.summary: Stock futures declined in pre-market trading as Meta's AI infrastructure concerns spooked markets, affecting tech and industrial stocks. Oil prices surged above $100/bbl amid U.S.-Israel plans against Iran. American Express beat earnings expectations but missed on revenue, while SLB Corp. outperformed estimates. Economic data shows weakening consumer sentiment with PMI and University of Michigan surveys expected to decline.

items.title: Pre-Markets Remain Spooked by AI Investment Capacity
items.summary: Pre-market futures declined on October 23, 2026, following a -2.6% Nasdaq drop on Thursday amid concerns about AI infrastructure investment viability. American Express beat earnings estimates but missed on revenue and fell in pre-market trading, while SLB Corp. beat both earnings and revenue expectations and gained ahead of the opening bell. Economic data expected later include flash PMI reports and University of Michigan Consumer Survey, with oil prices elevated due to geopolitical tensions.
